# Paula Magdy — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Full-stack software engineer in Cairo, Egypt, working across TypeScript, PHP,
> and Python on AWS, Azure, and Huawei Cloud.

## About
Paula Magdy is a full-stack software engineer working across TypeScript
(NestJS/Next.js), PHP (Laravel), and Python (Django/Flask) on AWS, Azure, and
Huawei Cloud. Comfortable owning a feature from the data model to the deploy
pipeline, he works on cross-functional teams delivering government and
enterprise platforms. Recent work includes services holding 5,000+ concurrent
users, API latency down about 35%, and deployments cut from roughly 20 minutes
to under 5. Works at Challenge Group (Full-Stack Software Engineer, Jun 2025 –
present). Alumnus of October 6 University (B.Sc., Computer Science and
Information Systems). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Cloud
Practitioner; Huawei Cloud HCCDP – Solution Architectures and HCCDA – Tech
Essentials certified.

## Availability
Open to full-stack engineering roles and consulting engagements, including remote
work (based in Cairo, UTC+2). Typically replies within 24 hours.

## Selected Work
Built at Challenge Group, mostly as a member of cross-functional delivery teams; the
Azure delivery and the support chatbot were delivered independently. Full case
studies (role, system context, contribution, stack) are on the home page.
